key_highlights: ASX slides as oil hovers near US$100, fuelling rate-hike bets; big four banks fall (BHP.AX, CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX under pressure)
Iron ore weakness spreads across the sector, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
RBA perceived as 'choosing recession' amid weakest business conditions since pandemic; rate-hike expectations rising
Australian housing: high-end prices hit by steepest falls, buyer sentiment collapses, though affordable segment resilient
WA gold sector active: Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania, Gateway all advancing projects; Flagship adds copper; Patriot locks Peruvian silver
Austal jumps on US$1.9b bid; Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market
Geopolitical: Trump-Iran war drags on, China-Trump tensions escalate, oil supply risk elevated
Data centre energy demand strains NSW grid; power giant seeks to co-locate AI centres at coal plants

sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural downtrend ('drowning, not waving'); gold and copper counter-cyclical strength in WA; Austal bid provides M&A catalyst
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from weak iron ore and China-Trump trade tensions. Gold names (Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania, Gateway) and Flagship (copper) offer relative strength. Austal bid creates short-term upside.

sectors.trend: Big four banks fall on rate-hike fears and weak business conditions; private credit stress (Bathla) raises systemic concern
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX pressured by rising rate expectations compressing equity valuations. Bathla collapse signals credit-cycle risk. Qantas $35m payout (QAN.AX) a minor cost item.

sectors.trend: Oil near US$100 on Iran conflict; data centre power demand strains NSW grid; coal-to-data-centre pivot discussed
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil spike. Energy transition disrupted by AI data centre load (headlines 53, 54). Coal-to-power repurposing creates niche opportunities.

sectors.trend: Housing buyer sentiment collapses; high-end prices falling sharply; affordable segment resilient; NZ house crash echoes
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face rental pressure. Consumer discretionary (WES.AX, WOW.AX) under pressure from weak sentiment. Housing construction (MPL.AX, GPT.AX) hit by sentiment collapse.

sectors.trend: AI build-out continues despite backlash; CoreWeave demand outstrips Nvidia supply; Brookfield leverages power+digital; ATO vs Big Tech tax fight
sectors.implications: Limited direct ASX exposure but data centre energy demand benefits utilities. ATO enforcement (headline 66) could impact tech M&A structures.

key_themes: Oil at US$100 driving inflation and rate-hike fears across ASX
Iron ore structural weakness vs. gold/copper counter-cyclical strength
RBA tightening cycle perceived as recessionary; business conditions at pandemic lows
Housing bifurcation: luxury crash vs. affordable resilience
Geopolitical escalation (Iran, China-Trump) as macro risk amplifier
AI data centre energy demand disrupting Australian power planning
Private credit stress (Bathla) signalling broader credit-cycle deterioration

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour domestic energy producers (WDS.AX, WLE.AX); monitor OPEC+ response
Reduce rate-sensitive REIT and property exposure; favour dividend-paying financials with strong NIM

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold (A2M.AX, NGF.AX) and copper (STO.AX)
Avoid high-end property plays; monitor NAB.AX, CBA.AX loan-loss provisions; Bathla fallout in private credit

risk_assessment.risk_factor: NSW power shortfall / data centre load
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor AGL.AX, CGP.AX, INC.AX for grid investment catalysts; watch AEMO capacity auctions

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight WA gold producers on counter-cyclical strength and project pipeline
opportunities.rationale: Gold benefits from geopolitical risk, rate uncertainty, and AUD weakness; multiple WA projects advancing (Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania, Gateway)

opportunities.recommendation: Add domestic energy producers on oil spike
opportunities.rationale: US$100 oil supports WDS, WLE, SXG earnings; Iran conflict provides sustained premium

opportunities.recommendation: Copper and silver exposure via Flagship and Patriot
opportunities.rationale: Copper soars on supply constraints; Patriot's 5-year Peruvian silver access de-risks exploration

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and rate-sensitive REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in structural decline; RBA tightening pressures property valuations; business conditions at pandemic lows

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim big four bank positions pending rate-path clarity
defensive_moves.rationale: Rate-hike bets compress equity multiples; Bathla credit stress raises loan-loss concerns

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash / short-duration bonds as hedge
defensive_moves.rationale: Elevated geopolitical and policy uncertainty; 'war on equities' narrative gaining traction

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 (^AXJO) likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Oil at US$100 sustains inflation, reinforcing RBA hawkish bias. Iron ore weakness drags materials. Rate-hike bets weigh on banks and REITs. Gold and energy provide relative outperformance. Expect volatility around Iran headlines and RBA communications.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. If RBA forces a recession (headline 58), cyclical and property names face further downside. Gold, copper, and energy remain structurally supported by geopolitics and AI-driven demand. Housing bifurcation persists. China-Trump trade dynamics are the key swing factor for iron ore and AUD.
